# RYTHM Company OS

> RYTHM Company OS is a governed AI workforce platform for building and operating specialized AI Agent teams, Company Memory, meetings, approvals, projects, actions, and traceable execution under Human CEO authority.

Canonical site: https://rythm-os.com
Product status: Public Beta
Operator: Tayyebialashti Yaser E.V. (Hungarian individual entrepreneur)
Registration number (Nyilvántartási szám): 58642889
Hungarian tax number: 48332376-1-42
Business address: 1143 Budapest, Gizella út 35, Hungary

## Core operating principles

- Human CEO authority: consequential authority remains human.
- AI identity is explicit: AI Agents are represented as organizational members with defined roles and boundaries.
- External actions are locked by default: publishing, spending, deploying, or messaging externally requires an authorized path.
- Tenant-aware data boundaries and traceable operating events are part of the product model.
- The public Demo is synthetic and read-only.
